thread:
maria: Quick sync — recruiting 8–10 early integrators for a short inference pilot to validate private deployment onboarding, quantization tradeoffs, and SLA handoffs. Timeline: 4 weeks. Need screening criteria + feedback cadence + incentive plan. Who can own recruiting?
ara: I can draft the screening flow. do we want product + infra signoff on candidate tech constraints?
jamal: yes — must confirm VPC access + KMS options up front. also flag: some partners will need on-prem bake vs VPC.
sophie: success metrics proposal (short): p95 latency < 250ms for short-chat; 95% of eval prompts pass quality threshold (>= baseline); per-1k-token cost delta < 20% vs baseline. also capture qualitative CSAT after week 2.
kevin: incentives: $3k credits + 2 months free dedicated capacity for high-touch integrators. assign a single SE for onboarding. that combo sold well before.
maria: screening snippet for outreach (short): `1) primary use-case; 2) expected qps and avg seq len; 3) security constraints (VPC/KMS/on-prem); 4) success metric they care about; 5) approx timeline to launch` — @ara please expand to Google Form.
ara: will do. suggested cadence: week0 onboarding + integration, week1 technical checkpoint (30m), week2 quality review (1h), week4 wrap + ROI doc. collect Loom recordings + a shared Notion board with feature-requests tagged.
jamal: infra checklist (to send to candidates): `staging endpoint, test key, example curl, pre-provisioned VPC peering steps` — sample curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" \"https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'`
deploy-bot: Created doc: /notion/early-integrators-pilot — invited: maria, ara, jamal, kevin.
maria: owners: recruiting = ara, infra gating = jamal, incentives & GTM = kevin, eval metrics = sophie. next steps: @ara draft form by EOD Tues, @jamal send infra checklist and staging keys by Wed. :thumbsup:
kevin: also add renewal pathway: if pilot > success threshold, offer 6mo reserved trial and a case study slot.
sophie: plus a short post-pilot survey template — I'll attach to the Notion board.
maria: perfect. i'll run a 15-min kickoff Thurs to review candidate list and prioritize. thanks everyone.
